title: Linear Amplification Mediated PCR for the retrieval of lentiviral vector integration sites from tumors induced by insertional mutagenesis.
protocol: Perform DNA extraction in a dedicated hood for molecular biology.
Dilute and quantify the extracted DNA sample to avoid contamination.
Determine the vector copy number (VCN) per diploid genome before starting LAM-PCR.
Set up a 50-μl linear PCR reaction using 10× Taq polymerase reaction buffer.
Add template DNA ranging from 0.01–10,000 ng to the PCR reaction.
Include dNTPs (200 μM each) in the PCR reaction.
Add Taq polymerase (2.5 U/μl) to the PCR reaction mixture.
Pipette Primer LTRIa (0.5 pmol/μl) into the PCR reaction.
Pipette Primer LTRIb (0.5 pmol/μl) into the PCR reaction.
Add dH2O to adjust the final volume of the PCR reaction to 50 μl.
Perform initial denaturation at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Denature at 95°C for 1 minute.
Anneal at 60°C for 45 seconds.
Elongate at 72°C for 1 minute and 30 seconds.
Repeat denaturation, annealing, and elongation steps for 25 cycles.
Perform final elongation at 72°C for 10 minutes.
Perform magnetic capture as described in the canonical LAM-PCR protocol.
Synthesize double-stranded DNA according to the LAM-PCR protocol.
Carry out restriction digest using oligos for HIV-derived lentiviral vectors.
Ligate linker to the digested fragments.
Denature the ligated products.
Conduct nested PCR as per the LAM-PCR protocol.
Separate 5 μl of the second exponential amplification on a high-resolution Spreadex gel.
Tag the products of the second exponential amplification.
Sequence tagged products using the 454 GS Flx platform.
